import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from your_module import LabIncharge, Chemist, Admin, Patient

class TestLabIncharge(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lab_incharge_perform_lab_tests(self):
        lab_incharge = LabIncharge()
        lab_incharge.perform_lab_tests()
        self.assertTrue(lab_incharge.flag_set_in_prescription)

    def test_lab_incharge_update_reports(self):
        lab_incharge = LabIncharge()
        lab_incharge.update_reports()
        self.assertTrue(lab_incharge.flag_set_in_prescription)

    def test_lab_incharge_set_flag_in_prescription(self):
        lab_incharge = LabIncharge()
        lab_incharge.set_flag_in_prescription()
        self.assertTrue(lab_incharge.flag_set_in_prescription)

class TestChemist(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_chemist_deliver_medicine(self):
        chemist = Chemist()
        chemist.deliver_medicine()
        self.assertTrue(chemist.flag_set_in_prescription)

    def test_chemist_set_flag_in_prescription(self):
        chemist = Chemist()
        chemist.set_flag_in_prescription()
        self.assertTrue(chemist.flag_set_in_prescription)

class TestAdmin(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_admin_view_invoice(self):
        admin = Admin()
        invoice = admin.view_invoice()
        self.assertIsNotNone(invoice)

    def test_admin_view_reports(self):
        admin = Admin()
        reports = admin.view_reports()
        self.assertIsNotNone(reports)

class TestPatient(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_patient_view_invoice(self):
        patient = Patient()
        invoice = patient.view_invoice()
        self.assertIsNotNone(invoice)

    def test_patient_view_reports(self):
        patient = Patient()
        reports = patient.view_reports()
        self.assertIsNotNone(reports)

class TestSystem(unittest.TestCase):
    @patch('your_module.mysql_database')
    def test_system_deployed_on_heroku(self, mock_mysql_database):
        mock_mysql_database.version = '5.7.21'
        self.assertTrue(mock_mysql_database.version == '5.7.21')

    @patch('your_module.hospital_website')
    def test_system_accessed_via_hospital_website(self, mock_hospital_website):
        mock_hospital_website.browser = 'Google Chrome'
        self.assertTrue(mock_hospital_website.browser == 'Google Chrome')

    @patch('your_module.front_end_pc')
    def test_system_operating_system(self, mock_front_end_pc):
        mock_front_end_pc.os = 'MS Windows'
        self.assertTrue(mock_front_end_pc.os == 'MS Windows')

    def test_system_print_invoice_and_prescription_reports(self):
        admin = Admin()
        invoice = admin.print_invoice()
        prescription = admin.print_prescription()
        self.assertIsNotNone(invoice)
        self.assertIsNotNone(prescription)

class TestSystemConstraints(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_system_prevent_full_scan_of_patient_consultation_request_entity(self):
        patient_consultation_request_entity = PatientConsultationRequestEntity()
        self.assertFalse(patient_consultation_request_entity.full_scan)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
